notes:
- fix(auth): un-enrolling a Mac and enrolling it again works; it previously succeeded only once per machine
- fix(auth): the exit and un-enrol shortcuts work while a web page has focus
- fix(navigation): local files and external applications follow the secure browser switch instead of always being refused
- feat(navigation): opening an external application asks first
- fix(security): a site with an untrusted certificate warns and asks instead of loading silently
- fix(processes): listed applications are closed only while secure browser is on
- feat(policy): new switches for the window control buttons and address-bar suggestions
- feat(ui): optional minimize, maximize and close buttons, and minimize now stays minimized
- feat(ui): the address bar suggests pages from history and completions from the search engine
- feat(ui): two-finger swipe navigates back and forward on macOS
- fix(ui): the window no longer opens small after signing in
- fix(ui): the taskbar stays visible when secure browser is off
- fix(ui): an ordinary browser window can be closed again
- fix(guard): the locked window can no longer be dragged off the screen on macOS
- fix(guard): dialogs open in front of the locked window instead of behind it
- fix(guard): the locked window is restored whatever route leaves its shape
- fix(guard): keyboard shortcuts can no longer minimize, hide or quit the locked window on macOS
- fix(guard): overlay, virtual camera and touchpad gesture detection work on macOS
- fix(guard): turning secure browser on or off from the dashboard takes effect without a restart
- fix(updater): a brief network drop no longer aborts an update
- fix(updater): restart to update waits for the update helper instead of giving up early
- fix(crash): crash reports name the module that faulted
- fix(watchdog): sleeping the machine no longer reports a false freeze
- docs(guide): the Windows install guide uses Pluto paths
